Discover elevated urban living in this stylish 1-bedroom apartment at Binghatti Skyrise Tower B, Business Bay. Offering 1,021.93 sq. ft. of thoughtfully designed living space, this contemporary residence combines elegant interiors, premium finishes, and a prime location, making it an excellent choice for both homeowners and investors.

The apartment features a bright open-plan living and dining area, a modern fully fitted kitchen, and a spacious bedroom with built-in wardrobes and an en-suite bathroom. A private balcony provides the perfect space to unwind while enjoying views of the surrounding cityscape.
